nodes.label: Tiswell Maskable Icon 512px
nodes.rationale: The 'maskable' purpose variant for Android adaptive icons, where the launcher may clip the square to a circle, squircle, rounded square, or teardrop at its own discretion. Identical artwork to icon-512 but noticeably reduced in scale with a wider cream border, so the crop eats only background.

nodes.label: Adaptive Icon Safe Zone Inset
nodes.rationale: The mark is shrunk to sit inside roughly the central 80 percent circle rather than filling the square, which is why the maskable export cannot simply be the 'any' icon reused. A shared file would either waste space on launchers that do not crop or lose the outer sage ring on launchers that crop to a circle; two exports from one vector source resolves the conflict at build time instead of at runtime. The extra cream margin is doing real work here, not padding.
